artworks.title: a) Standing Woman with a Fan (recto); b) Study of a Man and Woman (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) watercolor and opaque watercolor on wove paper
b) watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on a red chair near a table. She faces a large window with moonlight coming in. Her hair is styled up with a curled fringe. She wears a dark gown with a high neckline, short sleeves, and shoulder details. The woman accessorizes with a pink choker and yellow opera gloves. One gloved hand rests on the table, which also holds a vase and a closed book or box. The dimly lit room has a dark curtain drawn to the side. The window shows a night sky with the moon and silhouettes of rooftops and chimneys.

artworks.title: Gideon and the Fleece, with the Selection of Gideon's Army
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor; fragment from Bible MS (German text on image verso)
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring a divine figure, a supplicant on a hill, and two figures by a stream. The painting shows a robed figure on a green hill, a divine figure emerging from a cloud-like formation, and two individuals interacting with a flowing stream at the base of the hill. The landscape is stylized with earthy tones and a distinct separation between the grassy area and the stream. The artwork is done in the style of medieval manuscript art.

artworks.title: The Passover Lamb
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor; fragment from Bible MS (German text on image verso)
artworks.description: The image depicts three men standing in a room. The man in the middle is bending forward slightly, as if touching a staff held by the man on the right. The man on the left stands slightly behind them. All three men have beards and different hair types. They wear red, blue, and brown robes and hold staffs. The room has a stone or tiled floor, a green ceiling, and a light-colored wall.

artworks.title: The Stoning of Naboth
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor; fragment from Bible MS (German text on image verso)
artworks.description: This is a painting of three figures in a confrontation, with two figures seemingly in the act of throwing stones. This is in the style of European medieval manuscript illumination. The painting depicts two standing figures, dressed in period medieval attire, engaged in throwing stones at a third figure. The figures are set against a simple background with some greenery. The use of color is limited but vivid, with emphasis on earthy tones and traditional pigments typical of the medieval era.

artworks.title: Isaac and Esau
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor; fragment from Bible MS (German text on image verso)
artworks.description: The image displays two individuals. One person is seated on a box-like structure, with a long beard and wearing a cap, a long robe with blue and red colors. The other individual is standing next to the seated person, wearing a suit with red and green sections, a hat, holding a spear and carrying a bird. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Michol Helping David Escape
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor; fragment from Bible MS (German text on image verso)
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a medieval scene with a fortification. It features a stone castle or tower with battlements, a fortified door covered in metal rivets, two figures interacting near a window, and another figure holding a spear. The ground is depicted as simple green grass. The style is cartoonish and illustrative, resembling medieval manuscript illustrations with flat colors and simple lines.

artworks.title: Frontispiece
artworks.description: The image features illustrated portraits of various English monarchs from the shoulders up, shown in different styles and with varying facial hair. The individuals face forward or slightly to the side, with some wearing crowns or hats. They are depicted in regal attire, holding scepters, and adorned with jewelry. Each portrait is framed in a circle with the monarch's name and title below. The central text reads, "England's Cronicle or the Lives & Reigns of all the Kings & Queens to the present Reign of K. William & Q. Mary." The background is textured, supporting the portraits and text.

artworks.title: Henry I, King of England
artworks.description: The image portrays a man from the waist up, seated in a regal position. He has a long, full beard, flowing hair, and a serious expression. He is wearing a crown, a patterned robe, and holding a scepter and an orb with a cross. The background is plain with inscriptions identifying him as Henry the 1st, King of England, and Duke of Normandy, with the number three visible near his shoulder.

artworks.title: John, King of England
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated and only showing the upper body. The man has facial features such as a long, pointed nose, a full beard, and a moustache. He has medium length, wavy hair styled with a part. The man wears a crown with floral designs, a robe with intricate patterns and a fur-like collar. He holds a scepter. The background shows plain space with text and the number "7" on the left.

artworks.title: Coats of Arms with Corner Portraits of Henry VII, Henry VIII, Edward VI, and Mary
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heraldic display. The composition features coats of arms arranged in a structured format with a central large crest accompanied by the Latin motto "SEMPER EADEM." The central image features a lion and a dragon supporting a shield. Surrounding the central emblem, numerous coats of arms represent various noble families or titles, each occupying a squared-off segment. Portraits within the corners frame the scene. Each coat of arms has distinct colors and symbols.

artworks.title: Family Tree with Portraits of Henry VII, Henry VIII, Elizabeth, James, and Charles
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a royal family tree. The image features multiple interconnected portraits of royal figures, each encircled and interspersed with detailed heraldic crests and coats of arms, all spread across a branching tree motif. The artistry of the drawing is intricate, with leaves and branches connecting the various elements, emphasizing the lineage and connections among the depicted figures. Each portrait is framed with ornate decoration, and text surrounds or accompanies many of the components.

artworks.title: Reges Anglia
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a genealogical chart. The image features an intricate family tree associated with English royalty, depicted through branches adorned with labels and descriptive text. At the top of the chart are two framed portraits. The tree's branches spread out across the page, displaying a complex network of names and titles, while decorative elements, such as crowns and heraldic crests, enhance the visual appeal. The scene below the tree includes architectural structures and landscapes.

artworks.title: Lime Kilns near Cardigan
artworks.description: The image shows an old stone structure with a thatched roof, situated on a stone arch with an archway underneath it and a ladder leaning against its side. The background features a tree line, lush trees of various shades, and a sky with clouds. Additionally, there are rocks, foliage, and a winding path or road leading towards the structure. The color palette consists of browns, grays, and hints of cream, and the brushstrokes suggest a quiet and timeless atmosphere.

artworks.title: Two Dead Chickens
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite
artworks.description: The image shows two birds tied together at the feet. The birds have detailed feathers and claws. The color palette includes light beige and dark brown ink for outlining and details, creating a monochromatic look. The birds are positioned in the center, with their bodies overlapping, and their heads facing downwards in the lower half of the composition.

artworks.title: Head of an Old Man
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of an elderly man's upper body, specifically from the shoulders up. He is depicted in a seated or slightly bent forward position with his head slightly tilted down, and his hand is raised and touching his chin. The man's facial features are detailed with pronounced brow lines, a large nose, and a wrinkled forehead. His hair is drawn short and sparse, with some stray strokes hinting at thin locks. He appears to be wearing a loose-fitting garment, hinted at by simple lines and shading around his shoulders and chest. There are no visible jewelry or objects held in the sketch. The background is plain and unadorned, consisting of light sketch marks on a textured surface.

artworks.title: Sleeping Infant
artworks.description: The image shows a sleeping baby lying on their back on a pillow. The baby has soft, round facial features with closed eyes and a slightly open mouth. They are wearing a bonnet and a long white gown with puffed sleeves and a sash. The background includes a bed with a cushioned pillow and draped fabric, possibly curtains or bed hangings.

artworks.title: Nine Heads
artworks.artist: Paulus Pontius after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The image features eight portraits of individuals showing their head and neck. The figures vary in orientations, angles, and expressions. The top row includes three older males with unique hairstyles and facial hair. The middle row shows an older man with short hair, a male with a curly beard, and an elderly woman wearing a head covering. The bottom row displays a young woman with a bun, a figure with long curly hair, and a child with closed eyes. The background is plain, emphasizing the detailed features of each face.

artworks.title: The Flagellation
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures positioned closely together. The central figure is sitting on a low seat or surface, surrounded by standing figures who appear to be interacting. The figures have distinct facial features, beards, and headgear, suggesting different roles or identities. Their hairstyles vary, with some having long hair and others wearing hats or helmets. They are depicted wearing loose robes or dresses, with patterns hinting at intricacies or authority. The scene is set within an architectural environment with columns and a checkered floor pattern, implying a structured interior space.

artworks.title: The Flagellation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures under an architectural structure with a checkered floor. In the center, one figure is in a vulnerable pose, surrounded by others holding weapons. The central figure is bound with hands in front. The surrounding figures have various facial expressions and are holding clubs. The drawing is monochromatic, with strong lines and shading creating texture and depth.

artworks.title: The Flight to Egypt
artworks.description: This is a black and white medieval style illustration depicting a group traveling on donkeys with an angel above. The detailed landscape includes figures dressed in robes with halos, cityscape in the background, and lush foliage in the foreground. The intricate line work highlights the cloaks and animal textures, depicting motion and depth. The angel holds a staff or scepter.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of a Saint
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a figure in a large cauldron filled with water, surrounded by flames. The central figure is positioned with hands together in a prayer-like gesture, surrounded by a crowd. The crowd consists of elaborately dressed figures, suggesting a setting from the medieval or early Renaissance period, marked by pointed hats and robes. There is architecture in the background, including buildings with detailed woodwork and a majestic edifice, implying an urban environment. The composition uses strong lines and shading to give depth to the scene, typical of woodcut or engraving styles that convey a narrative moment.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of a Saint
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure submerged in a large cauldron in a scene with mediaeval architecture and a public event. The artwork features a crowd of onlookers with varied expressions, medieval style clothing, architectural elements, and flames beneath the cauldron. The background includes buildings with ornate details, creating a sense of depth within a town or city square. Line work adds texture and depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Presentation in the Temple
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration showing multiple individuals gathered in a scene with a historical or religious theme. People are dressed in medieval or Renaissance clothing, featuring various headwear. A prominent figure stands on the left, reaching towards a woman on the right. Between them is a small child with a halo. They are surrounded by other individuals. The background shows an interior with ornamental columns.

artworks.title:
Copy of "Système de Magnée - Veritable Position de la Main et de la Plume" from François Magnée's
"Le Parfait calligraphe, ou Méthode pour apprendre soi-même a écrire en peu de leçons"
artworks.medium: stipple engraving printed in black and red on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a hand holding a feather quill pen, with strings tied around the fingers for demonstration. The image features a detailed illustration of a hand in a writing position, emphasizing the correct way to hold the pen. The background is plain, focusing on the hand and pen. The drawing shows depth and texture through lines and shading.
